head: Snapshots makes your iPhone an instant camera and photo booth
dek: In Snapshots, every photo slides out of a little printer and develops in front of you; the Booth takes three poses for a photo strip. It was #37 among paid Photo & Video apps on the US App Store on 3 November.
details: You can add captions and write a memory on the back. It costs $1.99 with in-app purchases, by Ryan Fredericks.
means: If you miss instant cameras and photo booths, this brings that feeling to your phone.
todo: Find Snapshots in the App Store.
